title: Transfer of Property Act, 1882 — Section 61 (Right to foreclosure or sale)

content.overview: The mortgagee's right to obtain a decree for foreclosure or sale is governed by section 67; section 61 deals with the right of a mortgagor who has executed two or more mortgages to redeem any one without redeeming the others, unless the mortgagee has a right of consolidation.
